items.question: Under what condition is a mantra designated as deprived of its power?
premises: A mantra may occur at the cessation of a limb.
In that position the mantra has its power taken away.
Such a mantra receives a specific designation.
items.inference: A mantra located at the cessation of a limb and deprived of power is so designated.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement between 'ye' (plural form) and singular 'mantro'/'sa' is unclear from the surface form alone.
items.plain_english: A mantra which, at the cessation of the limb, has its power taken away is called deprived of power.
